tools.name: load_tool
tools.description: List the lazy tools (name and one-line summary), or load the named lazy tools in one call. A loaded tool is in your tool list, with its full definition, from your next request; a call to a lazy tool before it is loaded is refused. Loading a tool does not enable it.

names.description: Tool names or tools.lazy-style patterns of the lazy tools to load, in one call: a tool name, mcp:<server>:<tool>, mcp:<server>:* or *. Omit names to list the lazy tools. Each pattern is limited to lazy tools; the total of matched tools is limited by the profile's tools.lazy_load_max.
